title: China Forum of Veterinary Cardiology (CFVC) 2024
description: The second China Forum of Veterinary Cardiology (CFVC 2024) was held in Shanghai from October 24 to 26, 2024.
detailDescription: The second China Forum of Veterinary Cardiology (CFVC 2024) was held in Shanghai from October 24 to 26, 2024. Organized by Shanghai Hongyu Medical Technology Co., Ltd. and supported by the Shanghai Minhang District Government, the summit brought together esteemed international cardiology experts and global veterinary practitioners from around the world. The distinguished speakers included Professor Christopher Orton (USA, Chair of CFVC), Professor Brianna M. Potter (USA), Dr. Claudio Bussadori (Italy), Professor Gerhard Wess (Germany), Dr. Kyoung-a Youp (South Korea), and Professor Takuma Aoki (Japan).
scale: 6+ Speakers (Speakers and Guests) · 20+ Countries (Actual Attendance) · 180+ Participants (Actual Attendance)
